mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near the Verona Public Library with temperatures sitting at a pleasant 67 degrees.

This October marks Community Planning Month in Verona, a time to honor our planning department staff. Additionally, residents are reminded to keep an eye out for letters regarding cross-connection water surveys to help protect our city's water supply.
There is plenty to do around town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On September 21, local police responded to a retail theft incident where an individual was identified and cited for taking candy from a store on East Verona Avenue.
Today is the perfect day to grab a scoop of Chocolate Heath Crunch. The Verona Culver's is open until 10 PM, so head on over and enjoy a treat.
